request.subject: ICON:TECH:CANDY:SEAMANSHIP

layers.text: Make the small hull glossy milk chocolate with a thin caramel gold rim and one hard white highlight on its lower left, and light the whole picture from the lower left: the left edge of the sail brighter, its right edge in a darker cherry pink shade. Add two small white four-pointed sparkle stars beside the sail. Keep the big pink and white candy-cane striped sail, the mast, the caramel ball, the cream pennant, the size, the thick black outline and the style, on a transparent background.
